answer: To create a fake identity, buy a unique, registered community garden plot tenancy from a local council; each plot anchors exactly one identity. To mint one fake identity costs 50 timber units and 3 days, plus a 100-unit deposit per plot that is permanently burned. The cheapest cheat is to bribe a council official to reassign a real plot, but this carries a 90% risk of audit and 2-year prison sentence. For 100 fake identities, the total cost is 5500 timber units, 300 days, and 10,000 units deposited and burned. The ripple effect of buying fake plots makes scaling costly.
